name: caller-principal-python-opted-in-pre-edit-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: A pre-edit that opts in with if_unheld: true must present its principal whatever session it names, because the holder check admits the caller's own identity, so that identity has to be proven. Session A was never claimed and sends no principal, and Python refuses it with the typed absent reason; without the opt-in the same request is admitted (warn_mode/04). Twin of the Node row with the identical setup and request (20).

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
